thread:
elda: Sunlit raised a billing issue 1 - promo credit only applied to main account after we rolled out split-billing for multi-tenant customers. They say subaccounts A/B/C didn't get the $1,000 onboarding promo. Total missing credits = $3,000. Also one subaccount was charged an extra reserved-node pro-rate $1,200 due to double-billing. Can finance help? cc @sophia
ben: Oof. Attach invoice(s) and event timeline?
billing-bot: Files uploaded by @billing-sync: https://redwood.cloud/invoices/SUN-INV-9001 (pdf), https://redwood.cloud/events/sunlit-split-billing.csv
sophia: Looking now. Split-billing flag was enabled during pricing-experiment PR-1288. Promo mapping mistakenly only applied to the parent customer. Also found duplicate charge for subaccount B from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-02 (pro-rate bug).
elda: Opened FIN-8430 with supporting CSV and screenshots. Customer requests credits to subaccounts and refund for duplicate pro-rate ($1,200) to card.
finance-lead: Policy: split-billing promo propagation bug -> retro credits ok. Refunds for duplicate pro-rate accepted. Use GL 4005 for promo reinstatement and GL 4012 for billing corrections. Approve both.
ben: Running billing-cli to create one refund and three credits.
billing-cli refund --invoice SUN-INV-9001 --subaccount B --amount 1200 --method pm_on_file --gl 4012 --note "duplicate pro-rate charge due to split-billing rollout"
billing-cli apply-credit --customer SUNLIT --subaccount A --amount 1000 --type promo --gl 4005 --note "onboarding promo reinstated (split-billing mapping bug)"
billing-cli apply-credit --customer SUNLIT --subaccount B --amount 1000 --type promo --gl 4005 --note "onboarding promo reinstated (split-billing mapping bug)"
billing-cli apply-credit --customer SUNLIT --subaccount C --amount 1000 --type promo --gl 4005 --note "onboarding promo reinstated (split-billing mapping bug)"
billing-bot: Refund created RF-2026-0899 (status pending). Credits created PC-2026-420, PC-2026-421, PC-2026-422 (applied to subaccounts). Linked to FIN-8430.
sophia: I'll queue an RCA and tag infra + product to add a post-rollout check to the split-billing experiment runbook.
elda: Messaging Sunlit with RF-2026-0899 and PC IDs. Told them refund ETA 3-5 business days, credits visible within 24 hours.
finance-lead: Thanks. Please include GL memos and mark FIN-8430 resolved once processor confirms refund. :white_check_mark:
